 Wizards at Bulls preview: Washington faces Chicago on the road Saturday
 by Albert Lee Oct 24, 2026, 1:43 AM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 The Washington Wizards play the Chicago Bulls tomorrow. Let’s go.
 Game Info 
 When: Saturday, Oct. 24 at 8 p.m. ET
 Where: United Center
 How to watch: Monumental Sports Network
 Injury Report 
 Wizards: Jamir Watkins and Tristan Vukcevic are out. AJ Dybantsa is day to day.
 Bulls: Nic Claxton is out.
 What to watch for 
 The Wizards are about to go on their first road trip where they will be out for three straight games. They began their first game of the season last Wednesday against the same Raptors team Washington is hosting and lost 135-92. Today, they played the Milwaukee Bucks and won 132-25.
 Tomorrow should be winnable despite the loss to the Raptors tonight, but the Bulls will be pumped of their own home opener.
